headings.style: Playful, friendly, tight tracking on large sizes to avoid feeling corporate

body.style: Clean geometric sans, highly readable for dense nutritional data

typography.hierarchy_rules: No more than 2 steps between heading sizes. Never center paragraphs by default.

colors.rules: Green for healthy/success states. Orange specifically for sugar/sodium warnings. High contrast text always.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-green-900/5 for cards to give a subtle organic outline.
visual_enhancers.radius: Generous rounded corners: rounded-3xl for main cards, rounded-full for buttons.

surfaces.bottom_tab_bar: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-t border-black/5. NEVER transparent.
surfaces.cards: Solid background #FFFFFF or #F0F5ED. No glassmorphism on data cards.

components.cards: Squishy, rounded-3xl, generous padding (p-6). Mobile-first bento grids.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). The center 'Scan' button on the tab bar MUST be oversized (e.g. h-16 w-16), protruding upwards with a drop-shadow and a vibrant green background.
components.rings: Chunky, bright SVG rings for daily macros (Calories, Protein, Carbs, Fat, Salt, Sugar) with rounded stroke caps.
components.forms: Large tap targets (min 48px height), rounded-2xl inputs, friendly placeholder texts.
components.testing: MANDATORY data-testid on all interactive elements.

layouts.strategy: Mobile-first PWA. On desktop, constrain the main layout to max-w-md mx-auto with a subtle background outside, mimicking a phone frame.
layouts.spacing: Generous padding p-4 to p-6 on mobile containers. gap-4 or gap-6 between dashboard widgets.
layouts.bento_grid: Use high-density mode for the Nutrition Dashboard: Calories (col-span-full), Macros (col-span-1 squares).

motion.interactions: Bouncy, spring-like active states (scale down to 0.95) for buttons.
motion.page_transitions: Slide up for the Scan camera view. Subtle fade for tab switching.
motion.charts: Animate rings filling up on load.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over green or orange meets WCAG AA (use white or dark text accordingly).
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all tab icons and buttons.

image_urls.description: Colorful salad bowl for onboarding or empty states
Soothing abstract gradient for profile headers or auth backgrounds
Happy teen eating healthy, useful for onboarding

media.icons: lucide-react with strokeWidth={2.5} for a chunkier, friendlier feel.

libraries.charts: recharts for weekly tracking (bar/line), custom SVGs for daily chunky rings.
libraries.animation: framer-motion for tab bar active indicator and scan button pulse.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build entirely as a mobile-first UI. For desktop view, wrap the main app in a max-w-md mx-auto container with relative positioning and overflow-hidden to mimic a mobile screen.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds behind text if there's an image. Use backdrop-blur and a semi-solid color.
For the bottom tab bar, ensure safe-area padding at the bottom (pb-6 or pb-safe). The central 'Scan' button must break out of the tab bar upwards, using absolute positioning (-top-6).
Data rings in the Nutrition Dashboard should be thick, colorful, and friendly, not thin and corporate.
Use JS files (.js/.jsx) as per the environment constraints. Do not output .tsx files.
Ensure the orange accent is used explicitly for warnings (sodium, sugar).
Embed `data-testid` on all inputs, buttons, and tab links.
Language is bilingual ID/EN - provide a toggle in Profile and mock bilingual strings.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and tab bars.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container text globally.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped, bouncy interaction).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠) for icons.
Prioritize existing ui components before creating new ones.
Use sonner for toasts (located in ui/sonner.jsx).
